summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with parametrized valid/invalid cases plus a non-node input test. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (40 passed) using the shared venv interpreter. Nothing is committed. One deviation: a guard rejects non-Node inputs such as None, since None would otherwise act as a graph wildcard. mypy, black, and isort are not installed in the venv, so type-ignore codes and formatting were checked by reading only.
